title: CDBO study metadata call output
description: Generated from CDBO 0.4.1-draft. Do not edit by hand.

Analysis_Settings.description: Analysis settings that affect results, such as smoothing kernel, thresholds and preprocessing choices.

Analysis_Software.description: The software used to analyze the images, as named in the article.

Analysis_Software_Version.description: The version of the analysis software.

Atlas_Parcellation.description: The atlas or parcellation used to define brain regions.

Covariates.description: The covariates included in the statistical model.

Image_Resolution.description: The spatial resolution of the acquired images.

Imaging_Modality.description: The imaging modality and contrast analyzed.

Magnetic_Field_Strength.description: The magnetic field strength of the scanner.

Morphometry_Method.description: The analysis technique used to measure brain structure, as a coarse category for filtering. The software, version and settings are recorded in their own fields. Candidate values for the NIDM-Terms vocabulary in InterLex.

Multiple_Comparison_Correction.description: The method used to correct for multiple comparisons, with its threshold.

Operating_System.description: The operating system on which the analysis ran.

Pulse_Sequence.description: The pulse sequence and its main acquisition parameters.

Scanner_Manufacturer_Model.description: The manufacturer and model of the MRI scanner.

Statistical_Test.description: The statistical test or model used for the group comparison or association.

Study_Dataset.description: The dataset or cohort whose participants were studied, as named in the article. Used to flag claims that share a cohort and are therefore not independent.

Study_Design_Type.description: The design of the study, for example case-control, longitudinal, cross-sectional or mega-analysis.
